open.title: VERDICT WATCH: 2 newsrooms report a Tupac Shakur Murder Trial Guilty verdict — engine can't self-confirm, nothing published
open.body:
2 independent newsrooms report the same outcome — **Guilty** — and no outlet asserts a different one, but that is below the 3-family bar the engine requires to publish a criminal verdict on its own. The site has published NOTHING and set no verdict.

Reported by: news3lv, 8newsnow

- News 3 Las Vegas: DA applauds guilty verdict in Tupac Shakur murder trial: 'Wasn't a difficult decision'
  https://news3lv.com/news/local/clark-county-da-steve-wolfson-guilty-verdict-press-conference-tupac-shakur-murder-trial-duane-davis-keffe-d-las-vegas-shooting-crime
- 8 News Now: 'Forever grateful,' family of Tupac Shakur issue statement after Keffe D found guilty in Las Vegas murder
  https://www.8newsnow.com/news/tupac-murder-trial/forever-grateful-family-of-tupac-shakur-issue-statement-after-keffe-d-found-guilty-in-las-vegas-murder/

This is the RED LANE (AGENT.md §3b). A human confirms the outcome against the sources, then EITHER the aftermath is written on approval, OR the engine publishes on its own once a 3th independent family drops a fresh report inside the 12h window. The verdict is never inferred from this alert and never published automatically from it.
